polozky.nadpis: OGC Announces Publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard
polozky.perex: The Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) is excited to announce the publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard , which defines a lossless compression format for LAS 1.4 point cloud data.
polozky.telo: The Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) is excited to announce the publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard , which defines a lossless compression format for LAS 1.4 point cloud data. LAZ uses lossless compression to reduce the size of a LAS file while maintaining the general structure of the LAS format. The LAZ 1.4 format is based on LAS 1.4, as specified in the LAS Specification 1.4 — R15 by the American Society for Photogrammetry Remote Sensing (ASPRS), also an OGC Community Standard. LAZ compresses the point data block, while other LAS 1.4 structures, such as the header format, remain unchanged, although some header fields are slightly changed. polozky.nadpis: Esri User Conference 2026: What the Sessions Add Up To
polozky.perex: More than fifteen thousand people filled the San Diego Convention Center for Esri’s 46th annual User Conference this year, with roughly that many more watching by livestream from 117 countries.
polozky.telo: More than fifteen thousand people filled the San Diego Convention Center for Esri’s 46th annual User Conference this year, with roughly that many more watching by livestream from 117 countries. Taken session by session, the program is a wide survey of a mapping platform still expanding in every direction. Taken together, it resolves into a smaller number of recurring bets — about where AI belongs in a GIS, about how far one platform can scale, and about what all of it is ultimately for.
